guide.name: Pokey
guide.description: Like a swarm of ants, a roaming pack of Pokeys can devour a grown cow in less than five minutes. Favorite Target: Anything

guide.name: Octo-Ooze
guide.description: The slimy Octoooze soaks up fire power like a sponge so other monsters can wreak havoc. Favorite Target: Defensive Towers

guide.name: Fink
guide.description: Found deep inside Amazonia, Fink's chemo-receptors make its attacks deadly accurate. Favorite Target: Anything

guide.name: Ichi
guide.description: Discovered on the peak of Mt. Fuji, Ichi is one of the deadliest monsters and can withstand intense damage from towers and traps. Favorite Target: Defensive Towers

guide.name: Bandito
guide.description: Bandito's thick exoskeleton and impeccable accuracy make it the perfect monster assassin. Favorite Target: Anything

guide.name: D.A.V.E.
guide.description: D.A.V.E. only listens to its master and has a habit of completely destroying bases. Favorite Target: Anything

guide.name: Bolt
guide.description: Bolt is fast as lightning and can run ahead of your other monsters to munch on buildings with its razor sharp teeth. Favorite Target: Harvesters, Town Halls and Silos

guide.name: Eye-Ra
guide.description: Warning: Eye-ra's chemical makeup combusts within close proximity to walls. Favorite Target: Walls

guide.name: Fang
guide.description: Fang's bite releases a toxic venom which liquidates any target. Favorite Target: Anything

guide.name: Wormzer
guide.description: Wormzer utilizes his burrowing ability to launch surprise attacks and evade even the toughest walled defense. Favorite Target: Anything

guide.name: Teratorn
guide.description: With its swift wings and fiery breath, the flying Teratorn rains death from above. Favorite Target: Anything

guide.name: Zafreeti
guide.description: From deep within the Sahara, comes the mystical Zafreeti healer.

guide.name: Brain
guide.description: Cunning and greedy, Brain's pulsating cerebral cortex and high intelligence make him perfect for looting resources. Favorite Target: Harvesters, Town Halls and Silos

guide.name: Crabatron
guide.description: Using its claws to snap towers like twigs, Crabatron strikes fear into the heart of its enemies. Favorite Target: Defensive Towers

guide.name: Project X
guide.description: A government experiment gone terribly wrong, Project X is programmed to attack defense towers in battle. Favorite Target: Defensive Towers

guide.name: Vorg
guide.description: Hatched in giant hives deep inside the asteroid belt, Vorg are flying alien healers with a penchant for mischief.

guide.name: Slimeattikus
guide.description: An unholy biological terror birthed in the Bangweulu Swamps of Zambia, the Slimeattikus dissolves foes on contact and fissions when attacked. Favorite Target: Anything

guide.name: Slimeattikus Mini
guide.description: A smaller slime that fights wherever its parent falls.

guide.name: Rezghul
guide.description: This mighty monster can bring fellow monsters back from the dead at will, making Rezghul the perfect addition to any Backyard barrage.

guide.name: Spurtz
guide.description: A magma-born pack attacker that charges the nearest structure and leaves scorched ground when defeated.

guide.name: Zagnoid
guide.description: A fast, tough tower hunter that deals double damage to defenses.

guide.name: Malphus
guide.description: A quick raider that leaps over walls to reach harvesters and resource pods.

guide.name: Valgos
guide.description: Burrows beneath the yard and deals double damage to walls.

guide.name: Balthazar
guide.description: A low-flying hunter that seeks defending monsters and occupied bunkers. Its talons deal triple damage to monsters.

guide.name: Grokus
guide.description: A heavily armored resource hunter that presses through fire to reach producers and pods.

guide.name: Sabnox
guide.description: Spits magma from range. Its shots deal double damage to towers.

guide.name: King Wormzer
guide.description: An armored burrower that sends a shock wave through nearby buildings when it attacks a new target.

guide.name: Gorgo
guide.description: Discovered inside the Bermuda Triangle, Gorgo is a powerful 'tank' monster of simian origin.

guide.name: Drull
guide.description: Covered in red obsidian scales, this two-headed beast delivers overwhelming damage during attacks.

guide.name: Fomor
guide.description: Known in the northern isles as the 'Flying Frog of Death', Fomor's presence provides a 'buff' to your monster army, granting armor and speed to nearby monsters.

guide.name: Korath
guide.description: Spawned in the magma pits of Inferno, Korath uses his massive body and fiery core to eliminate enemies.

guide.name: Krallen
guide.description: Born in the blood-soaked grasslands of southeast Asia, Krallen can survive in any climate - wet or dry. He thinks only of his next kill.

guide.name: Radio Tower
guide.description: Never be caught off guard again! Get email alerts while you're away from your yard.

guide.name: Town Hall
guide.description: The hub of any great yard and the first building you need to build. Upgrading the Town Hall unlocks new buildings, features and lets you upgrade other buildings to a higher level.

guide.name: Hatchery
guide.description: Converts Goo produced by the Goo Factory into the creatures you have unlocked in the Monster Locker

guide.name: Monster Housing
guide.description: Stores the creatures you produce in the Hatchery , upgrade or build more to increase capacity.

guide.name: Twig Snapper
guide.description: Produces Twigs. Used in the construction of buildings

guide.name: Pebble Shiner
guide.description: Produces Pebbles. Used in the construction of buildings

guide.name: Putty Squisher
guide.description: Produces Putty. Used in the construction of buildings

guide.name: Goo Factory
guide.description: Produces Goo. Goo is used in the Hatchery to produce monsters.

guide.name: Storage Silo
guide.description: Increase your banks capacity of Twigs, Pebbles, Putty and Goo.

guide.name: Sniper Tower
guide.description: Long range, high damage, but slow to reload. This tower picks off enemy monsters before they even get close. Protect a larger area with this tower.

guide.name: Cannon Tower
guide.description: Short range but high damage, this towers shells explode on impact, great for taking out tightly-packed groups.

guide.name: Tesla Tower
guide.description: Talk about evil science, this high voltage tower fries any enemy that gets within range. Upgrade to improve number of shocks per charge, damage per shock and range.

guide.name: Fortification
guide.description: A simple block, use it to build walls to protect buildings and channel attackers into traps or closer to towers. Can be upgraded from wood to stone to metal to gold to black diamond.

guide.name: Monster Academy
guide.description: Through a demanding curriculum of physics, philosophy and physical education, your Monsters will earn their PhD in Advanced Destruction. Failing that, we have a large supply of steroids.

guide.name: Wild Monster Baiter
guide.description: Sprays a musk into the air that Wild Monsters can't resist causing them to flock to your base, a great way to test your defenses. If it gets too much for you the building has a siren you can use to scare them off.

guide.name: Monster Flinger
guide.description: Flings your monsters into battle! This building is required if you wish to attack another player. Use the Map Room to find and target enemy yards.

guide.name: Monster Locker
guide.description: Research and unlock new monsters to hatch in the Hatchery .

guide.name: Monster Juicer
guide.description: Got some unwanted monsters in your Housing ? Want to make space for bigger and better things? Want to make a sacrifice to the Backyard Gods? Then this is the building for you! Recycle Monsters back into Goo with minimal suffering.

guide.name: Laser Tower
guide.description: Deadly and fast, this plasma energy tower zaps any invading enemy at the speed of light.

guide.name: Aerial Defense Tower
guide.description: Fast-firing cannon designed to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of hostile air action.

guide.name: Heavy Trap
guide.description: Invisible to enemies until it's too late, Heavy Traps use a specialized trigger that only fires when the most powerful monsters step on it, but cause splash damage to all nearby units.

guide.name: Monster Bunker
guide.description: This defensive housing allows monsters to fight to the death defending your base.

guide.name: Booby Trap
guide.description: Invisible to the enemy until it is too late. Triggered when a Monster steps on it, deals large damage to a small area. Place close to buildings or use walls with gaps to group attackers into a small space.

guide.name: Monster Lab
guide.description: Research top secret abilities for your monsters. In war, science rules!

guide.name: Catapult
guide.description: A siege weapon, the Catapult hurls Twig at enemy bases to damage buildings. Upgrade to increase firepower!

guide.name: Champion Cage
guide.description: Hatch and evolve a Champion Monster to attack your enemies and defend your base.

guide.name: Champion Chamber
guide.description: This building allows you to change out your active champ, keeping inactive ones safe on ice until you call them forth again. (Frozen champs aren't hurt even when the Champion Chamber is completely destroyed.)

guide.name: Map Room
guide.description: Look around the world, find and help friends and select other players yards to attack.

guide.name: Yard Planner
guide.description: Quickly move some things around or completely remodel your layout! This building gives you a birds eye view of your Yard and makes moving buildings a snap.

guide.name: Regional Outpost
guide.description: Upgrading the Outpost unlocks new buildings, features and lets you upgrade other buildings to a higher level.

guide.name: Resource Outpost
guide.description: Resource Outpost description

guide.name: Stronghold
guide.description: Stronghold description

guide.name: Outpost Defender
guide.description: Outpost Defender description

guide.name: Chaos Lab
guide.description: Research Chaos Weapons to unleash more mayhem on your enemies.

guide.name: Chaos Factory
guide.description: Construct and launch Chaos Weapons to destroy your enemies.

guide.name: Railgun
guide.description: An electrical gun that accelerates a conductive projectile along a pair of rails, the Railgun Tower makes up for its limited range with high damage and an infinite line of fire.

guide.name: Quake Tower
guide.description: Creates an earthquake that does damage to all monsters in a certain area.

guide.name: Blast Tower
guide.description: Bombards ground invaders. A shell hits hardest at the center of its blast.

guide.name: Magma Tower
guide.description: Fires bursts of molten rock that do massive damage.

guide.name: Spurtz Cannon
guide.description: Your very own Backyard shotgun! This Cannon fires a Spurtz militia to do your bidding - just what you need to stop groups of invaders dead in their tracks.

guide.name: Black Diamond Spurtz Cannon
guide.description: The Black Diamond Spurtz Cannon boasts stronger durability and reduced reloading times. Your enemies will need a monster miracle to get past these!

guide.name: General Store
guide.description: Spend your Shiny on time saving upgrades.

guide.name: Hatchery Control Center
guide.description: Control all of your Hatcheries from a single building. You add monsters to one build queue and it sends instructions to whichever Hatchery becomes available first.

guide.name: Stone Block
guide.description: A stronger stone block takes longer to knock down. Protect key buildings from attackers.

guide.name: Under Hall
guide.description: The center of operations for your Inferno base.

guide.name: Bone Cruncher
guide.description: Breaks up Bones so they can be used as construction material.

guide.name: Coal Extractor
guide.description: Extracts Coal and reduces it to dust to be used in construction.

guide.name: Sulfur Swirler
guide.description: Mixes Sulfur into a state where it can be used to aid in the discovery of new monsters.

guide.name: Magma Pump
guide.description: Pumps Magma from underground sources for use in creating monsters.

guide.name: Resource Pod
guide.description: Stores Bones, Coal, Sulfur, and Magma for future use.

guide.name: Incubator
guide.description: Converts Magma into flesh and blood monsters to do your bidding.

guide.name: Compound
guide.description: Provides your monsters with a place to heal and hang out in between battles.

guide.name: Flinger

guide.name: Infernal Academy

guide.name: Hatchery

guide.name: Hatchery Control Center
guide.description: Welcome to the HCC. This building gives you control over all your Hatcheries. It also allows you to see when your housing will be full so you better plan your monster army.

guide.description: The Wild Monster Baiter (WMB), which sprays a intoxicating Monster Musk, attracts Wild Monsters and allows players to test their defenses.

guide.description: Welcome to the Yard Planner. This building gives you a birds eye view of your Yard and makes it quick and easy to move buildings around.

guide.description: You can only produce monsters you've unlocked in the Monster Locker. Select a monster on the left and start unlocking!

guide.name: Monster Bunker
